confirmedRecipientCount.description: Unique recipients with authoritative delivery confirmation for the original send.

confirmedRecipients.description: Optional complete list of confirmed recipient snapshots, each with a Photon userId and the handle used for the original send. User IDs must be unique, and both fields must be visible to the caller. The list length must equal confirmedRecipientCount. Persist the snapshots with the terminal outcome. Omit when the full confirmed set cannot be identified or disclosed; omission does not mean zero deliveries.

bcc.description: Omitted means unavailable or undisclosed; an empty array means known empty. Never infer hidden recipients from another observation.

cc.description: Omitted means unavailable or undisclosed; an empty array means known empty. Never infer hidden recipients from another observation.

from.description: The captured sender mailbox. Its address and resolved User ID must agree with the source Message's sentBy.

replyTo.description: Omitted means unavailable or undisclosed; an empty array means known empty. Never infer hidden recipients from another observation.

sourceMessageId.description: The Message that supplied this observation. In a Message Space snapshot this is the containing Message's own ID, not its parent ID.

to.description: Omitted means unavailable or undisclosed; an empty array means known empty. Never infer hidden recipients from another observation.

name.description: The captured display name, when known.

userId.description: The resolved Photon User ID, when available. Outbound admission must resolve every mailbox before capture.

EmailMailboxAddress.description: The captured mailbox address. Preserve local-part case; admission services own normalization and sending restrictions.

app_installation_id.description: Public App installation ID. Present only on App webhook deliveries.

organizationId.description: Public organization owning the event's project. May be absent on older events.

latestAddressing.description: The latest eligible whole observation on a canonical Space, or this Message's immutable capture in an embedded Space. Absent when no observation is available.
